\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 197-199 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R202-first-pass-words-from-chapters-197-199}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a lawsuit and a vote.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item football, hockey, tennis, chess, playing cards
  \item an aeroplane, petrol, a petrol station, a seat, a platform
  \item a citizen, a tourist, a sentence, a mistake, a rule
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Football? (\textbf{\bn{ফুটবল}}, \emph{phuṭbôl}.) Hockey? (\textbf{\bn{হকি}}, \emph{hôki}.) Tennis? (\textbf{\bn{টেনিস}}, \emph{ṭenis}.) Chess? (\textbf{\bn{দাবা}}, \emph{dābā}.) Playing cards? (\textbf{\bn{তাস}}, \emph{tās}.) An aeroplane? (\textbf{\bn{বিমান}}, \emph{bimān}.) Petrol? (\textbf{\bn{পেট্রোল}}, \emph{peṭrol}.) A petrol station? (\textbf{\bn{পেট্রোল} \bn{পাম্প}}, \emph{peṭrol pāmp}.) A seat? (\textbf{\bn{আসন}}, \emph{āsôn}.) A platform? (\textbf{\bn{প্ল্যাটফর্ম}}, \emph{plæṭphôrm}.) A citizen? (\textbf{\bn{নাগরিক}}, \emph{nāgôrik}.) A tourist? (\textbf{\bn{পর্যটক}}, \emph{pôrjôṭôk}.) A sentence? (\textbf{\bn{বাক্য}}, \emph{bākyô}.) A mistake? (\textbf{\bn{ভুল}}, \emph{bhul}.) A rule? (\textbf{\bn{নিয়ম}}, \emph{niyôm}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 200-202 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R202-second-pass-words-from-chapters-200-202}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a war and freedom.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a war, freedom, a law, a duty, success
  \item a basin, a shower, a drawer, a cloth bag, a glass
  \item low tide, a thief, a robber, a lawsuit, a vote
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A war? (\textbf{\bn{যুদ্ধ}}, \emph{juddhô}.) Freedom? (\textbf{\bn{স্বাধীনতা}}, \emph{svādhīnôtā}.) A law? (\textbf{\bn{আইন}}, \emph{āin}.) A duty? (\textbf{\bn{কর্তব্য}}, \emph{kôrtôbyô}.) Success? (\textbf{\bn{সাফল্য}}, \emph{sāphôlyô}.) A basin? (\textbf{\bn{বেসিন}}, \emph{besin}.) A shower? (\textbf{\bn{শাওয়ার}}, \emph{shāoyār}.) A drawer? (\textbf{\bn{ড্রয়ার}}, \emph{ḍrôyār}.) A cloth bag? (\textbf{\bn{থলে}}, \emph{thôle}.) A glass? (\textbf{\bn{গ্লাস}}, \emph{glās}.) Low tide? (\textbf{\bn{ভাটা}}, \emph{bhāṭā}.) A thief? (\textbf{\bn{চোর}}, \emph{chor}.) A robber? (\textbf{\bn{ডাকাত}}, \emph{ḍākāt}.) A lawsuit? (\textbf{\bn{মামলা}}, \emph{māmlā}.) A vote? (\textbf{\bn{ভোট}}, \emph{bhoṭ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
